description: Priority resolution matrix for multi-code scenarios
resolution_rule: When multiple codes apply to same claim, select code with LOWEST rank number (highest priority)

CRITICAL.description: Fundamental eligibility problems that immediately disqualify claims
CRITICAL.business_impact: HIGH - Claims cannot proceed without resolution

HIGH.business_impact: HIGH - Financial risk of duplicate payments

MEDIUM.business_impact: MEDIUM - Data quality issues requiring correction

resolution.action: Flag 340B issue first, formulary issue noted for secondary review

resolution.rationale: Days Supply Invalid (rank 14) has higher priority than RX ID Invalid (rank 16)
resolution.action: Fix days supply first, then validate RX ID

resolution.rationale: Hospital Pharmacy (rank 3) has higher priority than Excluded List (rank 6)
resolution.action: Both are exclusions but hospital status is more fundamental

resolution.rationale: Within same priority group (MEDIUM), lowest rank wins
resolution.action: Fix quantity issue first as it may impact days supply validation

algorithm.step_1: Collect all detected codes with their ranks
algorithm.step_2: Sort by rank (ascending - lowest number = highest priority)
algorithm.step_3: Select code with lowest rank number
algorithm.step_4: Store alternative codes for secondary review
algorithm.step_5: Return primary code with evidence trail

tie_scenario.description: Same rank number (should never happen with current design)
tie_scenario.resolution: Use code number as tiebreaker (lower code number wins)
tie_scenario.example: If somehow both rank 5, code 301 beats code 305

all_codes_same_rank.resolution: Select first detected code, log warning for configuration review

factors.impact: More alternatives = lower confidence in single-code resolution
Larger gap between primary and secondary = higher confidence
Different priority groups = higher confidence in resolution

thresholds.high_confidence: Rank gap >= 5 or different priority groups
thresholds.low_confidence: Rank gap 0-1 or multiple same-rank codes

optional_review: Alternative codes exist but clear priority
MEDIUM or LOWER priority codes only
